newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Form Holdings offers 27.21 mln shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Form Holdings offers 27.21 mln shares in IPO.

text.p: Music and video production group Form Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it was offering 27.21 million shares at Singapore $0.38 each in its initial public offering (IPO).
The offer comprises 23.32 million new shares and 3.89 million vendor shares, it said in a statement.
The company will place out 6.80 million shares and the rest will be offered to the public.
The shares, to be listed on the second board SESDAQ, are offered at a forecast weighted price earnings ratio of 10.4 times.
For the year ending December 31, 1997, the group expects to achieve a turnover of S$36 million and net profit of S$2.8 million.
Net proceeds from the new shares of about S$8.0 million will be used to diversify the group's business into post-production operations.
Some of the funds will be used to start up operations in Thailand and Taiwan and about S$2.5 million will be used to repay borrowings.
Form's principal activities are the production and distribution and licensing of entertainement products in the Asia region.
It makes childeren's educational video products in Singapore and also has licensing agreements with international recording labels to produce and distribute music titles.
Turnover for the group was S$22.7 million in 1996 and pretax profit was S$2.9 million.
The offer closes on September 1 and Trading is expected to begin on September 3.
